notes.title: Achievements and OST - Next steps for The Forest Quartet
notes.content:
It's been quite a crazy launch period! Reading the reviews and messages is heartwarming, seeing people enjoying The Forest Quartet and relating to its story fills us with hope and motivation. So, thank you, for purchasing the game. 

The Forest Quartet's launch sale is coming to a close, ending December 15th, in the meantime we are working on two things: achievements and an OST. 

The OST is made of 7 tracks, featured throughout the game. The original jazz score is composed by Mads' father (Kaspar Vadsholt), Nina is voiced by his sister (Nina Vadsholt, artist name: NV-4), the soundtrack is performed by select musicians from The Danish Radio Big Band based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

This is the album composition so far: 
 Title
 Ghost
 Midnight Between The Pines
 Fredskov
 Night Owls And Early Birds 
 Montage
 In My Garden
The achievements will soon be brought to The Forest Quartet on Steam as well. As it has been requested from messages we've gotten recently. 

So that's all for now, if you had a good experience playing The Forest Quartet please consider leaving a review, as that is the best way to support the developer and please the algorithm gods <3

notes.title: The Forest Quartet is releasing December 8th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33021788/2bb302587dcfd5910393cc7b63925cafd2caa99e.gif

The Forest Quartet is a story of life, death, and jazz. 

In this minimalistic puzzle adventure you incarnate the spirit of a recently passed lead singer. Travel into the minds of the three remaining quartet members to reignite their musical spark as they deal with grief. 

In three unique acts, unveil the different emotional responses to Nina's death - depression, anxiety, and anger. With the help of a visually strong foundation, there are no written descriptions in-game. 

Here's what you can expect from The Forest Quartet:
 Spirit Power: Sing to interact with objects, create light with your fingertips. Glide, float, and transform into butterflies to explore the band members' psyches.
 A Story of Life: Live through heartbreak and loss. Recover from grief and restore the band’s musical spark.
 A Relaxing Gameplay: No written descriptions or instructions, progressively gain powers for your travels.
 An Audio Experience: Environments and objects add unique layers to the soundtrack. Whether it be crackling forest fires or the cold winds from the deep caverns.

To celebrate this once in a lifetime occasion, we made a brand new trailer
[previewyoutube=7hURlmRC1UY;full][/previewyoutube]
Mads Vadsholt has been working on The Forest Quartet for the past 6 years, as a personal form of expression and a way to materialize his life into something to be shared. 

The Forest Quartet is a family-made project. The original jazz score is composed by Mads' father (Kaspar Vadsholt), Nina is voiced by his sister (Nina Vadsholt, artist name: NV-4), the soundtrack is performed by select musicians from The Danish Radio Big Band based in Copenhagen, Denmark.


We hope you enjoy this wonderful experience, 
- The Bedtime Team

notes.title: The Demo is back for only a limited time!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Mads here, developer of The Forest Quartet. 

The people over at Dreamhack are organizing one hell of a festival, where you can play a ton of games. So do check that out. 

For this demo, there have been a couple updates! So even if you've played it before, you might want to check out the little things I've been working on. 

It will only be available for the duration of Dreamhack (July 24 - 31) so don't wait until the last minute!

Some updates:

 Optimized the game to run on lower end graphics cards 
 New song in the graveyard (vocals by my sister!)
 Small effects when interacting with objects
 More ambient jazz in the level
 New generator sounds


Hope you will have fun, I'll be checking the Steam forums for any feedback :)
 - Mads signing out
